mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 months but 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases by more than 0.5pp but 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals strengthening supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases for 3 months but 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2.5% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) shows an annualized increase of less than 2%, it indicates a potential monetary policy misalignment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the described conditions are met but 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 70% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 over the previous month, coupled with an increase in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points, signals labor market distress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the described conditions are met but 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 10% signals a weakening in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST declines by more than 10% over 3 months but 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 2% over the previous quarter signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases by more than 2% over a quarter but 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances.
